reviewContext.issueReference: round-3-audit:feat/ai-capture@a964ad5 (base 0a35708); no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-touching-cap-interference (R3-1; car3-g1-capture-raster): shared-cap and opposed-frame shared-side contact give no hatch, zero candidates and pairs, and native exit 0 with --fail-on-interference in both rasterizers at threads 0 and 1-8; 0.01 mm overlaps give one pair and exit 1; shading unchanged; witness work fully charged.

function-capture-translucent-layer-visibility (R3-2; car3-g1-capture-raster): every translucent layer in front of the nearest opaque hit is composited in (depth, body) order and marked drawn; single capped worker arena with band-restart and bottom-row lifecycle; over-cap refuses with the existing message; single-layer bytes unchanged.

function-cad-drag-multitarget-cut-to-add (R3-3; car3-cad-drag): outward drag on a two-target Cut stores Add, positive distance, first displayed target, status ok, one undo entry; one Undo restores Cut and stored order; inspector and viewport share extrude-targets.ts.

performance-cad-intermediate-solid-retention (R3-4; car3-cad-evaluate): limits enforced inside tool builds and after every feature through holds and an evictable map; measured peaks within limits plus held operands; zero-entry handoff and many-body linear trim tests; replay, atomicity and exactly-once release unchanged.

performance-cad-face-frame-history-replay (R3-5; car3-g2-cad-history): one shared geometry context per lookup; profileBuilds 39/79 for 40/80 chains versus measured quadratic baseline; analytic frames and next-revision update.

performance-cad-shared-sketch-extrusion-rescans (R3-6; car3-g2-cad-history): cached entity failure and member index; statusVisits N and loopProbes 2N versus measured N^2 baseline; loop order, errors and capture bytes unchanged.

performance-native-artwork-attachment-byte-roundtrip (R3-7; car3-native-attachment): Rust attachmentDataUrl; zero attachment/base64/btoa calls; data URL, SVG and PNG equal the legacy oracle on the same multi-MiB file; release binary matches the oracle hash; refusals and first-use caching preserved.
Integration: bun run typecheck, bun run lint, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run test-cli and the *.test.ts scan all exit 0.
nonGoals: Editing interference.rs, overlay.rs, capture-interference-options.ts, manifold-kernel.ts, worker-host.ts, construction.ts, sketch-authoring.ts, CadViewport.tsx, export-command.ts, bundle-command.ts or packages/ir/src/image.ts.
Changing messages, exit codes, limits, or goldens other than those the design names.
Editing impl-plans/README.md, lockfiles or indexes, archiving plans, workspace-wide formatting, git commits, branches or worktrees during plan execution.
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-three audit of feat/ai-capture (base 0a35708, head a964ad5) found seven major defects: touching caps fail interference checks; a translucent sheet hides a PCB reference in image and report; an outward viewport drag on a multi-target Cut stores an invalid multi-target Add; cold CAD evaluation retains intermediate solids beyond cache limits; face-attached sketch frames replay ancestors quadratically; shared sketches are rescanned per extrusion; native 2D capture round-trips attachment bytes through Boa per byte.
constraints: Work only in this working tree on feat/ai-capture; no push, no history rewrite, no other worktrees; no server, auth, secrets or deployment config.
Follow AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and a per-plan CARGO_TARGET_DIR under target/.
Indexed reads must type-check under noUncheckedIndexedAccess; packages/io must not depend on @nodetto/core; packages/core/src/pcb depends only on itself.
Heavy per-pixel, per-vertex and per-byte work stays in Rust for the native CLI (Boa is 40-100x slower).
Captures stay deterministic; goldens change only where a finding requires a visible change.
Every fix has a regression test that fails before and passes after; performance tests assert deterministic counts, not wall-clock time.
Never relax or delete existing tests or deadlines; timing tests may be retried up to three times.
Per-plan verification is focused; workspace-wide typecheck, lint, mise run verify and test-cli run once at integration.
No *.test.ts files may remain under target/ or tmp/; evidence goes to tmp/car3-r3/<planId>/.
New dependencies need compatible licenses recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; no copying third-party code.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-1: picture-interference witnesses use volume-boundary ownership at shared caps and sides in both rasterizers; shading keeps facet identity.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Touching faces have zero shared volume (docs/capture.md:88,102-106); design-ai-capture.md 21.1 R3-1.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-2: composite every translucent layer in front of the nearest opaque hit in (depth, body) order using one capped worker arena; over-cap refuses with the existing message.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reference bodies blend at 45% and visible-through bodies count as drawn, with bounded work and storage; design-ai-capture.md 21.1 R3-2.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-1 and R3-2 are grouped in car3-g1-capture-raster.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Both change raster.rs and raster/reference.rs (Raster::sample and bands).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-3: a shared extrude-targets.ts rule is used by the inspector and the viewport drag; distance, operation and targets commit in one editor command.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Round one fixed only the inspector; one rule prevents divergence and keeps one undo entry; design-cad3d.md 20 R3-3.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-4: cache limits are enforced during evaluation through holds and an evictable map, protecting active operands, atomic multi-target updates and published finals.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Measured peaks of 601 handles and 12.1M triangles against limits of 256 and 4M; design-cad3d.md 20 R3-4.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-5 and R3-6 are grouped in car3-g2-cad-history: one shared geometry context per page revision, plus a cached first entity failure and member-to-contour index per sketch.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Both edit history.ts; grouping avoids shared-file conflicts; design-cad3d.md 20 R3-5, R3-6.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R3-7: a Rust attachmentDataUrl host path reads, sniffs and base64-encodes attachments; TypeScript keeps only the existing isRasterDataUrl regex and length check.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Removes about 12.6M interpreted callbacks for a 12 MiB file while keeping the exact data URL; design-ai-capture.md 21.1 R3-7.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: One wave of five plans with disjoint writePaths and no dependencies; artifactRoots [target, tmp/cad3d]; evidence root tmp/car3-r3 outside both.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Maximum concurrency; plan review confirmed no duplicate owners.

intentionalTradeoffs: The release-only R3-7 legacy oracle is slow (about 3.3M interpreted callbacks) but gives a byte-exact comparison.
Per-command logs live under target/car3-<plan>/logs/ inside an artifact root; progress logs record paths, exit codes and pre-fix literals in tracked files.
Sibling test suites overlap; worker rule 10 reruns after the sibling is done, which may serialize end-of-wave verification.
car3-g1-capture-raster sits at the 150-line plan bound rather than splitting the shared Raster::sample code.
supportedEdgeCases: Shared-cap and opposed-frame shared-side contact at every supported thread count; a 0.01 mm genuine overlap still reports a pair and exit 1.
Translucent sheet over a PCB reference; an opaque foreground still hides it; single-layer bytes unchanged.
Two-target Cut whose stored target order differs from display order; Undo restores the original stored order.
Zero-entry cache handoff, many-body linear trimming, multi-target failure atomicity and exactly-once release.
Editing an early extrusion updates every dependent face frame on the next revision; base-plane shortcut preserved.
Duplicate loop selections, selected-loop order and existing error precedence for shared sketches.
Attachment document-directory confinement, MIME and size refusals, first-use caching and multi-MiB rasters.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Desktop pixel output, real Manifold peak memory, native Boa elapsed time, allocation failures and watchdog behaviour (unmeasured residual risks).
Cross-platform determinism, golden regeneration and Rust rendering benchmarks beyond existing tests.

Accepted items: about 224 MB native CLI startup, cadCreationAllowed on cloud documents, 3D CAD capture only on native CLI and desktop, paired TS/Rust nmesh decoders, local copy in packages/core/src/pcb/lines.ts.

0.01 mm overlap controls give one pair; disjoint_scene(50) with analysis has witness 0 and pre-fix reads; stacked caps charged == no-flag charged + witness; existing exact read tests unedited.
